meta.source: MoSPI / International Institute for Population Sciences (IIPS)
meta.revisionPolicy: Survey estimates are final on release. Each round is a cross-section; the two rounds are compared by design but are never chained.
meta.coverage: All India, Rural + Urban (Combined); adult; NFHS-4 (2015-16) and NFHS-5 (2019-21)
meta.note: Two survey rounds: NFHS-4 (2015-16) and NFHS-5 (2019-21). Each sub-indicator is a cross-sectional estimate, never chained. Some sub-indicators are new in NFHS-5 and carry a null NFHS-4 value. Sector = Rural + Urban (Combined) throughout.
